messages:
Maya (eng-arch): Follow-up from the console query RFCwe need a concrete ownership + cutover plan for the mixed-execution model (fastpath vs tiling).
Omar (eng-runtime): TL;DR: fastpath = low-latency, duplicated checks; tiling = centralized RBAC + heavy aggregations. We need a safe incremental cutover.
Chen (eng-auth): We cannot have two divergent auth implementations long-term. Suggest signed allowlists (short-lived) handed to runtime to validate locally; control-plane remains canonical.
Rory (sre): Operational constraints: tiling p99 spikes will hurt many tenants. Recommend tenant-level noisy detection + throttling, and clear rollback gates.
Maya (eng-arch): Proposed responsibilities: platform-config owns route policy; runtime enforces lanes; auth provides signed blobs and sync fallback; SRE owns runbook + gates.
Omar (eng-runtime): Route metadata model: lane_hint (auto|fast|tiling), cost_score (0-100), force_override flag for devs. Runtime picks lane by hint or computed cost threshold.
Chen (eng-auth): Signed blob format: {exp, version, tenant_id, allowed_scopes, sig}. Runtimes verify sig and cache. On miss or expired blob we do synchronous auth call.
Rory (sre): Metrics we need before canary: per-route p50/p95/p99, auth-blob hit-rate, auth-sync qps, lane-switch rate, per-tenant queue depth, top-10 tenant p99. Alerts: lane-switch > 3%/5m, auth-sync spike, tenant-queue > 200.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created canary job "mixed-exec-cutover" scheduled 02:00 UTC.
Maya (eng-arch): Rollout plan: feature-flag + gradual traffic ramp 1%->10%->50%->100% with 30m holds. Gates: error-rate delta <0.3%, p95 <2x, p99 <3x, auth-sync delta < 10rps. Auto rollback on violation.
Omar (eng-runtime): Migration checklist: precompute blobs for hot tenants, rollout feature flag, add debug header (X-Exec-Lane) for tracing, add force_override.
Chen (eng-auth): Backfill: generate blobs from last 14 days of usage for hot tenants, version them (v1->v2) so runtime can read while rolling. Emit audit events when a blob is used vs a sync decision.
Rory (sre): Emergency abort: if p99 for any top-10 tenant > 5x baseline abort immediately. Also tenant-circuit: mark noisy tenant and route to throttled pool.
Maya (eng-arch): Testing: unit sig verification, integration path for blob-miss, chaos test simulating auth-store latency, 24h soak at 10% traffic.
Omar (eng-runtime): I'll open runtime PR with lane selector and force_override + local LRU cache for blobs (TTL 30s).
Chen (eng-auth): I'll add blob signer service and a small API to fetch blobs by tenant+version. Also emit blob_version and decision_source in auth logs.
Rory (sre): I'll prepare dashboards and run tenant-noise simulator to validate circuits.
Maya (eng-arch): Owners: Maya (coord), Omar (runtime), Chen (auth), Rory (sre). I'll draft the RFC follow-up with playbook and sample queries that must always be fastpath vs tiling. Sync tomorrow 09:30 PT.
Omar (eng-runtime): linking notes to repo: https://go/repo/arch/console-mixed-exec (PR to follow).
Maya (eng-arch): closing thread; ping owners on blockers.
